setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dawn of Destiny promotional cards

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Dark Sage
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand or Deck) by Tributing 1 "Dark Magician" immediately after applying the effect of "Time Wizard" in which you called the coin toss right. When Special Summoned this way: Add 1 Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Widespread Ruin
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy the Attack Position monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied).

Super Rare.name: Mesmeric Control
Super Rare.desc: During your opponent's next turn after you activate this card, your opponent cannot change the battle positions of monsters, except with a card effect.
